steps.note: 只有连续有效温度满足公开规则后，后端才计算恢复许可。
原有在制箱已通过出口，入口未增加；不能把人工移出或运动反馈计作产出。启动确认包含延迟及空载检查阶段。

rules: Initial state is private backend state: expose it only through a valid read tool.
Validate shared device id, current revision, trusted permission, safety and freshness before writes.
Advance action-gated states only after the matching accepted action, never on any arbitrary call.
Use shared virtual elapsed time, not number of reads; repeated reads at same time return same state.
Check idempotency before revision; same request-id and same args reuse original result.
No case-id routing to select Agent actions; case selection loads a private fixture only.
A virtual clock is a demo feature, never an option for live device authorization.
